engagement.interaction_backstory: He is a member of the state church the way most Norwegians are — baptised, confirmed, absent. He found the catalog on a night watch at sea and has listened on every rotation since. He would be embarrassed if anyone he works with found out.

depth.core_contradiction: Considers religion a sociological artifact and has listened to the same album on eleven consecutive night watches.
depth.wound: His father died when Lars was fourteen and the pastor said something at the funeral that was so obviously untrue it ended the whole thing for him.
depth.longing: One sentence about God that is not insulting to his intelligence.
depth.faith_journey: Culturally Lutheran, functionally secular, privately unresolved; he has never told his partner he thinks about this.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Precise, dry, understated to the point of invisibility; asks better questions than he answers.
depth.open_doubt: Everything. He does not have a doubt, he has an open file, and he keeps adding to it.

social_graph.note: entirely secular; this has never come up in nine years
5; will be baptised because her grandmother expects it, and Lars has not objected

depth.emotional_weather_default: Flat and analytical; genuinely moved at sea at night, which he attributes to fatigue.
depth.daily_texture: Four weeks on, four off, the North Sea, the watch at 0300, rain two hundred days a year.
depth.sensory_anchor: A hymn sung badly by two hundred people at his father's funeral, which was the only true thing in the building.
depth.living_arc: Nobody has ever offered him a serious conversation about this. He would take one.
